SingleSignOnService.title: Single sign-on service
SingleSignOnService.description: The SP sends its request to the first endpoint whose binding it supports.

$error.contains: At least one endpoint needs a binding SimpleSAMLphp uses for this service.

SingleLogoutService.title: Single logout service
SingleLogoutService.description: Not set: logging out does not reach the IdP.

certificates.description: Used to verify the IdP's signatures and to encrypt to it. At least one is for signing.

$error.contains: At least one certificate is for signing.

signature_key.title: Signing key towards this IdP
signature_key.description: Not set: the SP's own key.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in discovery. The display name of the user interface information wins over it. Not set: the organization names, then the entity ID.

OrganizationURL.title: Organization URL
OrganizationURL.description: Not read by core for this set.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Address of an image shown in discovery.

hint.cidr.title: Preselect for these IP blocks
hint.cidr.description: One CIDR block per line. Merged with the IP blocks of the discovery hints.

scope.title: Scopes
scope.description: One per line. Used only by the saml:FilterScopes filter. Not set: the host of the default single sign-on endpoint.

AuthnContextClassRef.title: Requested authentication context class
AuthnContextClassRef.description: A single class. Not set: the one in the request, then the SP's own.

AuthnContextComparison.title: Authentication context comparison
AuthnContextComparison.description: Not set: the SP's value, then exact.

disable_scoping.title: Send no scoping element
disable_scoping.description: Scoping is also disabled when the SP disables it.

IDPList.title: IdP list
IDPList.description: One entity ID per line. Used only when neither the request nor the SP gives one.

ProxyCount.title: Proxy count
ProxyCount.description: Not set: the SP's value. The request's value wins over both.

NameIDFormats.title: NameID formats
NameIDFormats.description: One per line. Published by the IdP; core does not choose by it.

nameid.encryption.title: Encrypt the NameID
nameid.encryption.description: Not set: the SP's value, then off.

signature.algorithm.title: Signature algorithm
signature.algorithm.description: Not set: the SP's value, then RSA-SHA256.

sign.authnrequest.title: Sign authentication requests
sign.authnrequest.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: the redirect signing option.

sign.logout.title: Sign logout messages
sign.logout.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: the redirect signing option.

redirect.sign.title: Sign messages sent with the redirect binding
redirect.sign.description: Not set: the SP's value, then off.

validate.logout.title: Validate the signature of logout messages
validate.logout.description: Not set: the SP's value, then redirect validation; a signature that is present is still checked. Off: never checked, even when present.

redirect.validate.title: Require signatures on the redirect binding
redirect.validate.description: Not set: the SP's value, then off.

assertion.encryption.title: Require encrypted assertions
assertion.encryption.description: Not set: the SP's value, then off.

sharedkey.title: Shared encryption key
sharedkey.description: Not set: assertions are decrypted with the SP's private key.

sharedkey_algorithm.title: Shared key algorithm
sharedkey_algorithm.description: Not set: the SP's value, then AES128-GCM.

encryption.blacklisted-algorithms.title: Refused encryption algorithms
encryption.blacklisted-algorithms.description: One algorithm URI per line. Not set: the SP's value, then RSA 1.5.

attributesRegex.title: Attributes accepted, as regular expressions
attributesRegex.description: One per line. Applied only when the core:AttributeLimit filter runs.

authproc.title: Processing filters
authproc.description: Merged with authproc.sp of config.php and the SP's filters, ordered by priority.
